messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-2.6.2 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

This is a bugfix release, mainly to address the fact that rpy2 is no longer
compatible with R < 3.2 (now there is an informative error message at build
time).

rpy2-2.6.2 is on pypi.

Best,


Laurent
